root_cause.text: The `vfe_isr()` function incorrectly uses the write master loop bound `MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM` (7) to iterate and call `vfe_isr_reg_update()`, which indexes the `vfe->line` array that is limited to `VFE_LINE_NUM_MAX` (4) elements, leading to an out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that `vfe_isr()` originally used a single loop bounded by `MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM` to call both `vfe_isr_reg_update(vfe, i)` and `vfe_buf_done(vfe, i)`. The patch splits this into two loops, using `MAX_VFE_OUTPUT_LINES` for `vfe_isr_reg_update()` and keeping `MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM` for `vfe_buf_done()`.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable loop in `vfe_isr()` where it iterates using `MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM` (7) as the upper bound: `for (i = 0; i < MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM; i++)`. Inside this loop, it calls `vfe_isr_reg_update(vfe, i)`, which uses `i` to index the `vfe->line` array. Since `vfe->line` is limited to `VFE_LINE_NUM_MAX` (4) elements, any index `i >= 4` results in an out-of-bounds array access.
